PR09: compile showcased snippets against the public barrel

Replace the lib-tree scan in snippet_api_guard_test.dart with a fixture
that imports only package:plate_editor_support/plate_editor_support.dart
and references every Plate* symbol the showcase snippets construct. The
test compiles the fixture, so a symbol hidden under lib/src (or renamed
or removed) fails the guard instead of being accepted by a source scan.
